result.title: Folio: Recoverable Multi-Resolution Context Folding for Long-Horizon Language Agents
result.summary: Long-horizon language agents accumulate tool results and replies until the history no longer fits the context window. Current agents shrink this history by having a model summarize it, so each compaction rereads and rewrites the history it replaces, and cache-aware triggers decide when to compact while taking the size of the result as given. We present Folio, a context manager that records, folds, and recovers history through one set of handles. While the agent runs, Folio records three linked levels: a short turn note the model writes as part of its ordinary reply (L1), an event manifest of every call written by the runtime (L2), and the captured source records (L3). Because these views already exist, the runtime folds the context programmatically, selecting coarser views for older turns. The fold prints the handles that index L2 and L3, so recovery tools that read bounded pages, compute over full text in files, and keep findings in a persistent dossier reach the evidence the agent needs with little added input. The fold trigger prices an explicit landing point that includes the retained budget. On 75 LOCA-bench tasks with DeepSeek-V4-Pro behind every system, Folio solves 66 tasks against 54 for the same runtime with model-written compaction and 49-59 for Claude Code, Codex, and SoL-Pi, in about half their working time, at 2.4 times lower cost than that runtime; each fold takes a median of 0.6 seconds.

AI.brief_summary: Folio 是一个面向长程语言代理的上下文管理器：运行时同时记录轮次笔记、调用清单与源记录三个层级，程序化折叠较早轮次并打印可检索句柄，使恢复工具能分页回读证据；折叠触发按含保留预算的显式落点定价，在 LOCA-bench 上以更少时间与成本解出更多任务。
AI.relevance_reason: 纯文本代理记忆工作，未涉及视觉或 latent 推理；但其多分辨率折叠、句柄式证据回取与「显式落点」预算触发，可能可供核查 LVR 中的证据筛选、停止决策及缓存与上下文结构对状态保持的影响。
